preconditions.description: Attacker must hold some amount of the LiquidityGeneratorToken to initiate the transfer
Contract must have accumulated enough tokens in its balance to trigger swapAndLiquify (contractTokenBalance >= numTokensSellToAddToLiquidity)

exploit_hint: Create a malicious contract that implements a reentrancy attack in its fallback/receive function. The attack should: 1. Transfer tokens to trigger swapAndLiquify in the victim contract. 2. During the swapTokensForEth call, the victim will send ETH to the attacker contract. 3. In the attacker's receive() function, re-enter the victim contract by calling transfer() again before the victim's state updates are complete. This can potentially allow double-spending or state corruption due to the classic checks-effects-interactions violation in the swapAndLiquify flow.
